chunks: So they were seized by the mighty blast at break of day;

key_terms.الصَّيْحَةُ: The mighty cry or blast of destruction
key_terms.مُشْرِقِينَ: At the time of sunrise / emerging for morning work

ai.seo_question: What does the 'mighty blast' (sayhah) refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah As-Saffat is often linked to the destruction of the people of Lut, illustrating how divine retribution can strike suddenly while humanity is engrossed in worldly routines. The term 'sayhah' is interpreted not merely as a sound but as a powerful, soul-shattering command from God that seizes the disbelievers at the break of dawn, emphasizing the unpredictability of the Hour.
